messages:
Maya Patel: FYI, I found ~600 hosted invoices mis-tagged as 'dedicated' in the APRIL exports. It skews revenue schedule and deferral calculations.
Diego Ramos: seriously? that's the APR export we used for month close?
Maya Patel: yep — looks like the parser mapping for plan_type changed after the pricing experiment on 4/12. attached sample rows.
Maya Patel: ```
invoice_id,customer,plan_type,amount,usage_period
inv-2024-00421,Acme Corp,dedicated,12000,2024-04-01/2024-04-30
inv-2024-00422,Acme Corp,hosted,300,2024-04-01/2024-04-30
```
Ava Chen: If hosted were mis-tagged as dedicated, deferred revenue recognition timing is off (annual commit vs pay-as-you-go). Need journal adjustments. Estimate impact?
Maya Patel: preliminary: ~$430k shift from deferred to recognized in April; accruals for reserved capacity overstated by ~$390k.
Tom W: @FinanceOps we need 1) a corrective reclass journal, 2) updated rev schedule, 3) note for auditors. Can we get approvals today? :grimacing:
Diego Ramos: I'll create the journal draft. Q: do we hit materiality threshold for quarter restatement? might be borderline.
Ava Chen: I'll rerun revenue_schedule for April/May after Diego's draft. Also add a footnote in revrec doc about pricing experiment mapping change.
Maya Patel: @RevBot please run a diff of rev schedule v2024-04-30 vs v2024-05-31 for Acme and similar commit customers.
RevBot: Running schedule_diff: completed. Output: 612 affected invoices, recognized delta $427,432, deferred decrease $390,000, monthly deferral smoothing needed. Link: https://redwood.internal/revrec/2024-apr/reclass-diff
Tom W: Ok approvals: @CFO can you sign off on corrective journal approach? We'll tag as non-recurring adjustment if within Q thresholds.
CFO (not in channel): (reacts with :eyes:) Will review. Send journal draft.
Diego Ramos: Draft posted in #finance-docs: /docs/journals/2024-04-reclass-draft.md — asking for review by EOD.
Maya Patel: Thanks. Also noted: vendor invoice timings for dedicated capacity were delayed — may require accrual top-up for May too.
Ava Chen: I'll coordinate vendor accrual check. cc @Tom W
Tom W: thx. keeping this thread for sign-off log.
